title: FeatureVector
description: Versioned feature envelope containing ordered static features extracted from an executable sample.

sample_id.description: Stable identifier of the analyzed sample.

sample_hash.description: Canonical 64-character lowercase SHA-256 digest of the sample.

feature_schema_version.description: Version identifier of the feature extraction schema (e.g. 'ember_pe_v1').

feature_values.description: Ordered numerical feature array. Non-null elements must be finite numbers. Missing elements are represented as null.

feature_count.description: Number of numerical feature values contained in the vector (must equal length of feature_values).

missing_value_strategy.description: Strategy applied for missing or unextractable feature elements: 'native_nan' encodes missing elements as null in JSON (converted to NaN at model loading); 'zero_fill' and 'mean_impute' require all missing values to have been imputed as finite numbers (null forbidden).

extraction_duration_ms.description: Optional elapsed duration in milliseconds required to extract features.

feature_names.description: Optional list of feature names corresponding 1-to-1 with feature_values.
